correctStatements.text: At 16:20 Florian reported SSO logins failing for all users with an error that the assertion was not yet valid.
At 16:24 Anneke diagnosed the error as clock skew, with the identity provider timestamps running ahead of ours.
Jomo said about 12,000 active sessions were expiring with nobody able to sign back in.
At 16:31 Priyanka measured the auth hosts at a 4 minute offset against NTP.
Priyanka found the NTP daemon had stopped on two of the three auth hosts after last Friday kernel patch.
At 16:38 Priyanka restarted chronyd on both hosts and forced a time step.
At 16:43 Anneke confirmed the offset was zero and test logins succeeded.
At 16:50 Jomo saw the login success rate return to 99.8 percent.
At 17:05 Florian closed the incident after sending communications to staff.
Priyanka will enable a chronyd service check in monitoring.
Anneke will raise the assertion clock tolerance from 30 seconds to 2 minutes.
Florian summarised that stopped time sync on the auth hosts caused clock skew that blocked all SSO logins for about 45 minutes.
